name: liveroom
description: Liveroom: a live room for your Claude Code session. Main model vitals, an on-call architect, every permission check, subagent cards and swimlanes, a turn receipt and a session log, all from real session events. Based on Flightdeck by Stephen Casella.

architectPattern.title: Architect pattern
architectPattern.description: Regular expression (case-insensitive) for the agent types and server tools that count as the on-call architect, e.g. advisor|architect|reviewer

architectLabel.title: Architect label
architectLabel.description: Name shown for the architect role

gateLabel.title: Gate label
gateLabel.description: Name shown for the permission panel

panels.title: Panels
panels.description: Comma-separated panels in display order: main, models, architect, gate, agents, codex, loops, skills, receipt, log. Leave one out to hide it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the connectors while real work flows, or keep them still

moments.title: Architect moments
moments.description: Show the inferred moment of each consult (before a plan, error repeats, before done)

matchDescriptions.title: Match agent descriptions
matchDescriptions.description: Also count an agent type as the architect when its description (not just its name) matches the pattern

maxCards.title: Cards before swimlanes
maxCards.description: Agent cards drawn side by side; more agents than this switch to swimlanes (1-6)

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: auto: a summary of at most 8 rows when the pane sits inline above the prompt, two columns from 110 columns when docked, one column otherwise

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the pane when a session starts

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show context, agents, consults and denials in the status line

delegationRule.title: Delegation rule
delegationRule.description: Flag (⚠ and a toast) a subagent whose spawn names no model and that runs on the main model, and a Codex hand-off that names no model or effort
